name: Rust Cross-Compilation (cargo-zigbuild)
description: Installs cargo-zigbuild plus the Zig toolchain (via pip's `ziglang` package - no manual tarball download/unzip) and adds a set of rustup cross-compilation targets, so `cargo xbuild --target <triple>` cross-compiles reliably without Docker/QEMU.

targets.description: Comma-separated rustup target triples to install for cross-compilation.
